description: Source code implementing MKLDNN-based binary tensor operations (add and multiply) with conditional support depending on MKLDNN compilation flag; includes function definitions for out-of-place and in-place operations, with support for zero-dimensional tensors and device consistency checks.

methods.name: mkldnn_add_out
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN addition of two tensors with output tensor, handling device and size checks.

methods.name: mkldnn_add
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN addition of two tensors, creating a new tensor if necessary.

methods.name: mkldnn_add_
methods.description: In-place MKLDNN addition of two tensors.

methods.name: mkldnn_mul_out
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors with output tensor, handling size checks.

methods.name: mkldnn_mul
methods.description: Performs MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors, creating a new tensor if necessary.

methods.name: mkldnn_mul_
methods.description: In-place MKLDNN multiplication of two tensors.
